definitions.name: Heat Sink
definitions.summary: Removes heat locally up to declared capacity.

definitions.name: Soother
definitions.summary: Capacity-limited stress reduction for eligible targets.

definitions.name: Filter Feeder
definitions.summary: Consumes contamination and converts it to satiety or declared benefit under conservation rules.

definitions.name: Growth Trigger
definitions.summary: Qualifying condition across declared ticks queues the next declared footprint stage.

definitions.name: Symbiotic Buffer
definitions.summary: Narrow conditional capacity-limited resistance or mitigation for compatible targets.

definitions.name: Reactive Pulse
definitions.summary: Bounded event on a named transition or state boundary with a finite trigger policy.
